raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the multi-criteria question and conflated data for different airports. After opening the FAA enplanements PDF, the Planner pivoted to LaGuardia (LGA) because it appeared ranked 17th, ignoring the requirement that the airport also be the largest in New England—a criterion that clearly points to Boston Logan International Airport (BOS), which was also served by American Airlines Shuttle. This faulty synthesis led the investigation toward the wrong airport.
